main.description: A slice of a session's transcript, for a PDS whose sign-in can't upload blobs yet. The garden.engram.session record for the session names its chunks in order. The record key is <session id>-<index>; not searched as a memory.

sessionId.description: The session this chunk belongs to.

index.description: The chunk's position in the transcript, from 0.

entries.description: How many transcript entries the chunk holds.

sha256.description: Of data, so a reader can check what it got.
